_instructions: CLINICIAN REVIEW TEMPLATE — one file per source reviewed.
Copy this file, fill in every field, then record it with:
Delete this _instructions key before submitting; the validator rejects unknown fields.
REVIEWER IDENTITY: reviewer_id is a PSEUDONYM issued to you out-of-band by whoever
administers the reviewer register. It must match 'rev_' followed by 8 lowercase
alphanumeric characters. Synapse never generates one. The pseudonym-to-person mapping
is held OUTSIDE this repository, so a clone of a source pack never carries identities.
EVERY assessment field is mandatory and must contain a substantive answer. Placeholder
values ('n/a', '-', 'tbd') are rejected. 'None identified' is a valid answer for
patient_safety_concerns; leaving it blank is not.
You are reviewing this source AGAINST ONE PACK'S DECLARED SCOPE. Read the pack's
README.md first: a source can be excellent evidence and still be wrong for the
population or purpose this pack serves.
SEPARATION OF DUTIES: you must not review sources whose discovery query you configured.
_relevance_prompt: Is this source relevant to the pack's supported topics? Name the topic it supports. If it only partially applies, say which part.
_population_prompt: Does the study population match the pack's intended patient population? State the study population explicitly and note any mismatch in age, comorbidity, setting or severity.
_evidence_quality_prompt: Assess study design, conduct and strength of evidence. Note sample size, control, blinding, follow-up, and whether effect sizes are clinically meaningful rather than merely statistically significant.
_limitations_prompt: What limitations must a patient-facing answer not overstate past? Include generalisability, surrogate endpoints, industry funding, and anything the abstract claims more strongly than the data support.
_safety_prompt: What could go wrong if a patient read a summary of this source before their appointment? Consider: could it discourage seeking care, encourage self-medication, cause alarm, or be misread as personal advice? 'None identified' is valid.
_decision_prompt: approved | rejected | needs_changes. 'approved' means: suitable for this pack's population, for this pack's stated use, with the limitations above made clear.
_rationale_prompt: Why this decision, in your own words. An auditor should be able to follow your reasoning without re-reading the source.
